integration_instructions: Inspect each attempt and every accepted source for one exact model at a time before updating that model's records.
For evidence already integrated into the exact candidate, add a dated source-reuse resolution naming the accepted source and stating the exact supported claim and all material caveats.

Where the source establishes a new useful fact not yet in the candidate, integrate it only if the evidence directly supports the exact model and field; retain conflicts, size/configuration limits, and missing mainland details.
Do not infer a precise weight from approximate claims, select among unresolved trims, turn fitted tires into maximum-clearance claims, or convert qualitative stiffness into a score.
Do not repeat searches, add sources or images, or make external GitHub changes.
done_criteria: Inspect all 25 frozen fields and accepted sources, integrate directly supported evidence or preserve an exact unresolved disposition, write a results matrix, accept monotonic coverage for ledger/catalog changes, run npm run check once for the batch, and run npm run image:report only if image records change.
delivery_boundary: Local worktree only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, or production change.
